topography.project_purpose: Swell is a non-custodial liquid staking and restaking protocol on Ethereum. It allows users to stake ETH or BTC to receive liquid tokens (swETH, rswETH, swBTC) that accrue staking rewards while remaining usable in DeFi. The protocol also offers yield-bearing vaults (earnETH, earnBTC) and a governance token (SWELL).
topography.relationship_narrative: The ETH liquid staking and restaking families share a common NodeOperatorRegistry and DepositManager pattern, while the BTC liquid staking family uses a separate Yearn-based infrastructure. The Earn vaults operate independently but may accept swETH, rswETH, or swBTC as deposits, creating a token flow between families. Governance and token contracts are shared across the protocol.
